name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.PLR.erase_unused_rows
title: Unused hidden rows: if a uniform k x n matrix U is published only through C U + W with C of full row rank, the view is uniform and independent of W
statement: Let K be a finite field, U a k x n matrix over K and C an iota x k matrix of full row rank (rank C = |iota|). Then for every iota x n matrix R exactly |K|^((k - |iota|) n) matrices U satisfy C U = R; consequently, for every pad offset W and every function F of the published matrix, the sum over all U of F(C U + W) equals |K|^((k - |iota|) n) times the sum over all R of F(R). For U uniform, C U + W is uniform and its law does not depend on W: the hidden values W padded by the used combinations of U are erased, and the k - |iota| unused directions of U contribute only the multiplicity factor.
